title: IP/Port/URL Allow-List & Egress Filtering Management for Microsoft 365 & Intune Endpoints
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (cross-domain endpoint troubleshooting/operations; diagnostic method + scripts, live-environment care).
Vendor/product-specific console internals are deferred to the vendor's official documentation; the Intune/Entra/Windows side is authored at exact click-by-click detail.
hook: Make sure your filters let cloud management actually work
problem: Tight egress filtering is required in regulated environments — but if the IP/Port/URL allow-lists miss a Microsoft 365, Intune, Autopilot, or Defender endpoint, enrollment stalls, policies never sync, and updates fail with no obvious cause. This solution gives you a repeatable way to administer network access controls for managed endpoints: build and maintain the required-endpoint allow-lists and proxy/firewall exceptions, validate reachability, and keep them current as Microsoft's endpoints change.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — why cloud-managed endpoints need specific egress access, the Microsoft required-endpoints model (M365, Intune, Autopilot, Defender, Entra), and the allow-list lifecycle.

Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (a proxy/firewall you administer, the required-endpoints source, change control, a pilot scope, Entra/Intune reachability) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.

Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps to derive the required IP/Port/URL set, build the allow-list / proxy exceptions, validate reachability on a pilot, then expand and keep it current as the endpoint list changes.

5 PowerShell scripts — required-endpoint + current-filter discovery, per-endpoint reachability validation, an allow-list coverage/gap report, safe allow-list update generation (preview first), and a target-group builder.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with pass/fail gates (endpoint reachable, enrollment/sync/update succeed), plus Best Practices for change control and drift review.
short: Administer the IP/Port/URL allow-lists and proxy/firewall exceptions that let Microsoft 365, Intune, Autopilot, and Defender endpoints work through tight egress filtering — built, validated, and kept current. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
short_plain: Administer the IP/Port/URL allow-lists and proxy/firewall exceptions that let Microsoft 365, Intune, Autopilot, and Defender endpoints work through tight egress filtering — built, validated, and kept current.
